texts: Launched ads to help cover hosting costs and allow me to continue spending time maintaining and developing the site. I'm still figuring out what works, so the actual specifics on where and how many ads there will be are subject to change over time. I want ads to make the site sustainable long term without being obstructive to everyone's experience. I'm open to suggestions through the feedback page if people have ideas or feel certain placements are problematic.

Patreon supporters have been added to the Support page. An option has been added to the Edit Profile to link a Patreon account if the user wants to display their username instead of Patreon name or if they want their name hidden.
Fixed an issue in the GMS Explorer where some text wasn't handling their styling properly.
